entities.name: Bess, Soul Nourisher
entities.description: Human cook in New Capenna who feeds down-city people for donations and once was Rocco's sous chef.

entities.name: Rocco
entities.description: Chef under whom Bess was a sous chef.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Upper district whose chefs Bess rivals.

events.summary: Bess broke away from Rocco to form her own kitchen serving the streets where she grew up.
events.quote: Bess broke off to form her own kitchen, seeking to bring her skills down-city

relations.quote: Once a sous chef under Rocco
